strings.mdKbSmart: • Smart keybox fetch: i-check to so kaplesan ya keybox sumpad Google's revocation list (CRL) tan salien toy nanduruman lapuan anggad makaromog na balido ya keybox, ya walay automatic backup tan i-restart na Google services. Manpapaandar ed kada tap tan kaukolan so internet (1-3 minuto).
strings.mdKbNet: • Keybox manlapud network: man-download na keybox manlapud opisyal a repository (GitHub) tan i-save ed /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. Kaukolan so internet tan mangala na 1-3 minuto. Inusar no ag-onkualipika so smart fetch odino no manual ya inuman so keybox.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • RKP diagnosis: nengnengen to ray walan Remote Key Provisioning modules, inspeksionen toy TEE attestation certificate version, tan ipapanengneng toy KmInstallKeybox tool state. Anggapoy manguuman — sakey a simplin pakanengnengan ed kipapasen na kagawaan.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Widevine check (read-only): mangipapanengneng na Widevine level indicators (L1/L3) manlapud dumpsys, DRM (IDM) key-file presence, tan saray misiglaotan ya system properties. Anggapoy nauman to.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Manual RKP fix: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh manual. Inayos to ray isyu ed attestation no ag ontalona so automatic pass. Kada dalagan et walay malinew ya linya na itatalona/inkagba.
strings.mdRkpFull: • Full RKP fix: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh full. Naasikaso to ray mairap ya kaso tan mas mabayag. Walay malinew ya resulta ya ompatnag ed sampot.
strings.mdGmsReset: • I-reset so GMS: linisan so Play Store tan Google ya serbisyo (GMS+GSF) ya data tan automatikon i-reboot so device. Parad saray masebeg ya paneknek labat — agton balot nadiwit iray litrato odino file mo.
strings.mdCertify: • Play certification: nengnengen so RKP certificate attestation state na device tan i-reset to ray attestation properties no nakaukolan. Ag-onsabi ed data na user.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER repair: inayos to ray isyu ed services framework (SOTER) ya misiglaotan ed device attestation. Uusaren ed pigaran kagawaan ya mandedependi ed SOTER imbes ya Play Integrity.
strings.mdPifApply: • I-apply so PIF: ipaandar so sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh ya puersa. Iyaplika so pinilin fingerprint (local/advanced) tan i-update iray pif.prop/pif.json ya file. Walay malinew ya resulta ya ompatnag ed log.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF check: ipapanengneng so aka-install ya estado na makina, saray fingerprint file (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), tan saray log. I-check labat — anggapoy nauman to.
strings.mdCanary: • Canary update: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m. Mangala na sankabaloan ya impaway na Canary Engine pian naseguro ya mipara ed saray mandatory RKP ya sertipiko (Pebrero 2026).
strings.mdEngineDiag: • Engine diagnosis: nengnengen so TrickyStoreOSS ya estado (pid, logs), saray keybox files (aktibo vs user), say tua vs spoofed device fingerprint, target.txt, security_patch.txt, RKP keys. Diagnostic display labat.
strings.hintKbSlots: Say module et mangaasikaso na duaran keybox slot: say manunan (sagrado, agbalot napunas) tan say komadua (backup). Ipapanengneng na sayan tab no dinan ya slot so aktibo, manguuman na preference, odino mangi-promote na secondary ed primary no walay malinew ya kerew — ya walay backup tan kompleton log.
strings.mdIntegrityDiag: • Integrity diagnosis: nengnengen so TEE key import, say library injection ed loob na keystore2, say revocation status (CRL), say protection-list coverage tan say RKP ya estado. Basaen labat — anggapoy nauman to.
strings.confirmIntegrityFix:
🔧 Maligen ya iyaplika lamet:

• Say listaan na proteksion et ginawa lamet manlapud kada in-install ya app.
• Say custom-ROM compatibility layer et inyaplika lamet.
• Say aktibon keybox et inyaplika lamet. restart.

Anggapoy nabura tan say manunan keybox et agbalot nadiwit.

Ituloy?
strings.mdKbSlots: • Keybox slots: ipapanengneng toy kipapasen na manunan tan komaduan slot tan iyalis toy labay ed baetan da. Say manunan (/data/adb/falcon/keybox.xml) et lanang ya protektado tan agbalot napunas. Say pangiyabanti ed segundaryo ed manunan et mankaukolan na malinew ya kumpirmasyon.
strings.confirmKbSlotsPromote:
⬆️ Promote the secondary slot to primary:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml becomes the primary slot content.
• The current primary is saved as a backup before replacement.
• Nothing is deleted — the operation is reversible.

Continue?
strings.confirmKbSlotsClear:
🧹 Ekalen so segundaryon slot:

• Say /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml et naekal.
• Say manunan slot et ag-asabi.

Ituloy?

strings.confirmKbSmart:
Smart keybox fetch (balo ed v3.17):

• I-check toy kaplesan ya keybox sumpad Google revocation list (CRL).
• Sasalien toy nanduruman lapuan anggad naromog so malinis ya keybox.
• Automatic backup + restart #000## serbisyo.

⚠️ Kaukolan so internet (1-3 min). Ituloy?

strings.confirmRkpManual:
Re-provision RKP keys:

• Anggapoy data odino keybox files ya nabura.
• I-reboot so telepono kayari to.

Ituloy?
strings.confirmRkpFull:
Full repair:

• Re-provisions RKP + restart Google services.
• Say device et automatikon man-reboot (anggapoy na-wipe).

Ituloy?
strings.confirmGmsReset:
I-restart Google services:

• GMS + Play Store + GSF — i-restart labat.
• Anggapoy na-wipe tan ag ka na-sign out.
• Say device et automatikon man-reboot.
strings.confirmRkpForce:
Force re-provision (Red Magic):

• Parad saray device ya ag da iimanoen so leaked keybox.
• Onkikiwas anggano mabunigas iray key.
• Anggapoy nabura ya data.

Ituloy?
strings.confirmCertify:
Piliten so Play Store certification:

• Naekal labat so Store cache — ag-apektado so account mo.
• I-reboot, insan mo lukasan so Store.

Ituloy?
strings.confirmSoter:
SOTER repair:

• I-restart so vendor.soter ya serbisyo.
• I-clear so SOTER server data labat.

Ituloy?
strings.confirmPifApply:
I-apply so fingerprint (PIF):

• I-convert so custom.pif.prop tan i-install ed engine path.
• Kaukolan ya i-reboot kayari to.

Ituloy?
strings.confirmCanary:
I-update so Canary fingerprint:

• I-download so sankabaloan ya opisyal ya Canary fingerprint manlapud Google.
• I-sync so security patch + i-restart so Google services (anggapoy wipe).

⚠️ Kaukolan so internet (1-3 min). Ituloy?
